# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are considered for the latest released mod version on actively maintained Minecraft workspaces:

| Workspace | Status |
|-----------|--------|
| `1.20.1` | Supported |
| `1.21.1` | Supported |
| `26.1.2` | Supported |
| `26.2` | Supported |

Older mod releases may not receive backports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues privately using
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/Much-More-Dungeons/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue or pull request that includes exploit details before maintainers have had a chance to investigate and release a fix.
